label: Демонстрационные данные
source: Прямое разрешение пользователя 13.10.2026 в чате КЛК Прототип
assignmentNote: Четыре сценария независимы и начинаются с исходного состояния. Два задания с V008 нельзя считать одновременно назначенными. Демонстрация не задаёт реальные правила доступности, статусы заявки или пересчёт KPI.
notificationNote: Синтетические иллюстрации разных сущностей по поручению пользователя; не реальные события и не подтверждение уведомлений из интеграций.
expansionNote: 14.10.2026: 7 дополнительных синтетических ТС в ремонте по прямому запросу пользователя: больше данных, scroll и фильтры.

compatibility.vehicleDriverId: vehicle.driverIds is canonical; driverId projects its first member
compatibility.vehicleType: vehicle.model now actual model; legacy Figma Vehicle/model intentionally projects vehicleType until renamed
compatibility.taskSingularResources: assignments.resourceRows is canonical; task.vehicleId/driverId project its first row
compatibility.demoRefusal: REFUSED_DEMO is synthetic; backend enum unknown
compatibility.unassigned: 8 tasks with status Unassigned in 8 NEW parents; refusal excluded
compatibility.freshness: Frozen demo clock, no verified API boundary; does not change lifecycle status
compatibility.phone: All contact phones are user-supplied placeholder
compatibility.crud: Permission-gated. No role-wide production rights inferred
compatibility.assignmentPreset: Figma second row is a fixed additional-resource example; real availability, uniqueness and validation are unverified.

catalogs.sourceNote: BA example KAMAZ6520/CLASS-DUMP retained; additional brands/models from authorized synthetic vehicles. 15.10.2026: user requested more catalog demo content while retaining BA one-level group-to-class structure. Three groups/eight classes; all additions are synthetic. Tanker, flatbed, crew bus and service van names reuse authorized demo vehicle types; catalog relations are not verified business NSI. Minibus, crane and aerial platform exist only as demo catalog examples, with no corresponding fleet claim. Related vehicle counts for brands/models derive from existing fleet; model6520 has0.
catalogs.classificationStatusNote: All displayed Active badges in the expanded classifier are demonstration values. Actual catalog statuses were not supplied. No model-to-class or fleet-to-class business mapping is inferred from these examples.

driverProfileProvenance.note: Категории, стаж, подразделение и дополнительные связи — вымышленные демонстрационные значения. Не являются кадровыми данными или правилом допуска к назначению.

driverDocumentsProvenance.basis: KLK source did not confirm license/medical fields; legacy EKTP UI-22 suggests this concept only. Dates and numbers generated solely for demo, no eligibility/medical fitness or verified document status inferred.

equipmentContentProvenance.basis: Original KLK materials and demo fixture contain 12 terminals and no links for15 of25 vehicles. These13 added records and links are authored content hypotheses, not production observations.
equipmentContentProvenance.limits: No availability, eligibility, or real telemetry inferred. Existing rows and relationships retained.
